name: Zeus Soldivice Le Tibarni
original_name: ゼウス・ソルディバイス・ル・ティバーニ
source:
The king who rules over the Elyos. From the human perspective, he is a god-like being. He has a long beard and exuded a dignified presence.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char10.html]Mink[/url]]
